αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (ἑὸν αὐτοῦ ’his own very own’): ’of himself’ · also the fixed adv. αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot, right here’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, governed by a preposition: ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ’from him’ · also intensive with a noun, masc. gen. sg.: ’Alcinous himself’ (αὐτοῦ Ἀλκινόοιο) · also reflexive intensive gen. sg. after a personal pronoun: σέο τ’ αὐτοῦ ’and of yourself’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun of a thing, ’from it’, after ἐκ (ἐκ δ’ αὐτοῦ πείρατ’ ἀνήφθω, of the mast) · also masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive sense, ’his own’: αὐτοῦ ἐνεύναιον ’his own bedding’, αὐτοῦ βώτορες ’his own herdsmen’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun with a noun, ’his’: ὀστέα δ’ αὐτοῦ ’and his bones’ · also intensive gen. sg. with a demonstrative and noun: τοῦδ’ αὐτοῦ λυκάβαντος ’this very year’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun of a thing, ’upon it’, after ἐπί (ἐπ’ αὐτοῦ, of a stool) · also gen. sg. pronoun of comparison after a comparative: ’than he’ (προγενέστερος αὐτοῦ ’older than he’) · also masc. gen. sg. after περί: ’about himself’ (περί τ’ αὐτοῦ καὶ περὶ πάντων) · also plain gen. sg. pronoun governed by ἄγχι ’near’: ’him’ (ἄγχι δ’ αὐτοῦ ’close beside him’) · also gen. sg. in a genitive absolute with a participle: ’with him himself still living’ (αὐτοῦ ζώοντος)
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg.: ’himself’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a 1st-person subject: ’myself’ (ἐγὼν αὐτός) · also masc. nom. sg. with a 2nd-person subject: ’yourself’ (εἰδήσεις δὲ καὶ αὐτός ’you will see for yourself’) · also masc. nom. sg., of a thing: ’it itself’ (αὐτὸς … σίδηρος ’iron of itself’)
αὐτῷ: αὐτός — self; masc. dat. sg.: ’himself’, reinforcing a personal pronoun (σοὶ δ’ αὐτῷ ’to you yourself’) · also used alone as a plain personal pronoun, ’him’, not reinforcing anything (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ μηχανόωνται ’are plotting against him’) · also with a noun, ’own, very’, in the dat. of accompaniment: αὐτῷ φάρει ’with the cloak itself, cloak and all’ · also reinforcing a 1st-person pronoun: ’myself’ (ἐμοὶ αὐτῷ) · also plain pronoun of a thing, ’it’, after a preposition (ἀμφ’ αὐτῷ ’around it’)
αὖ: αὖ — again, in turn, back; adv., shorter form of αὖτε
αὖτε: αὖτε — again, in turn, on the other hand; adv.
αὖτις: αὖτις — back, again, once more; adv. (= αὖθις)
βοὸς: βοῦς — ox, cow, heifer; gen. sg.
βροτός: βροτός — mortal, a mortal; masc. or fem. nom. sg. (adj. of two terminations, so also of a woman)
βροτὸς: βροτός — mortal, as opposed to a god; masc./fem. nom. sg.
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γήραος: γῆρας — old age; neut. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic γήρως)
γαίης: γαῖα — earth, land; gen. sg. (Ionic η for α)
γαίῃ: γαῖα — earth, ground; fem. dat. sg.
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γλαυκῶπις: γλαυκῶπις — epithet of Athena: ’gleaming-eyed’ (or ’owl-eyed’; sense uncertain); fem. nom. sg.
γλυκερῷ: γλυκερός — sweet; masc./neut. dat. sg. (ὕπνῳ γλυκερῷ ’sweet sleep’)
γούνατα: γόνυ — knee; neut. nom. pl., epic γούνατα (= Attic γόνατα)
γόοιο: γόος — wailing, lament; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
γύναι: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. voc. sg.: ’wife’ · also fem. voc. sg., plain address to a woman who is not a wife: ’woman’ (χαῖρε, γύναι ’be glad, woman’)
γῆ: γῆ — earth, land, country; fem. nom. sg. (Attic γῆ, epic γαῖα)
γῆράς: γῆρας — old age; neut. acc. sg.; with λιπαρόν: ’a sleek old age’, the object of ἵκοιο ’reach’
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δαήμεναι: δάω — learn, find out (aor. pass. ἐδάην); aor. 2 pass. inf., epic -ήμεναι (= Attic δαῆναι)
δαιμονίη: δαιμόνιος — strange, baffling, ill-starred; fem. voc. sg., epic -η (= Attic -α), reproachful address: ’strange one’
δακρύσασα: δακρύω — weep, shed tears; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having burst into tears’
διζήμενος: δίζημαι — seek, search for; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’seeking’
δολιχὴν: δολιχός — long; adj., fem. acc. sg., agreeing with ὁδόν: ’a long (journey)’
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῶκε: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔδωκε)
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also introducing an indirect question after a verb of asking or telling: ’whether’ (εἰ δή ’whether indeed’) · also in εἰ δ’ ἄγε, an interjectional idiom with the imperative: ’come now, well then’ · also with opt., in a wish: ’if only’ (εἰ … ὁμοφρονέοις … γένοιο) · also ὡς εἰ + opt., ’as if’ (ὡς εἰ … ἱκοίατο ’as if they had come’) · also ὡς εἰ, ’as if’, before a noun with no verb of its own (ὡς εἰ κέρα … ἠὲ σίδηρος ’as if horn or iron’)
εἰπέμεν: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic εἰπεῖν)
εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰμί ’be’: pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’ (τίς … εἰς; ’who are you?’) · also in the idiom εἰς ὅ (κε) ’until’: εἰς ὅ κεν … μιγήῃς ’until you mingle with’ · also in the idiom εἰς ὅτε (κε) + subj., ’until the time when’ (εἰς ὅτε κέν … καθέλῃσι ’until … brings down’)
εἴη: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 sg.: ’it might be, he might be’; impersonal + inf.: ’it might be possible for him’ · also in a wish with a dat. of the person: ’may there be (for us)’ (εἴη μὲν νῦν νῶϊν … ἐδωδὴ ’may there be food for us two’) · also in a wish after εἰ γάρ, ’if only (all things) were’ · also in a fear clause after μή, ’lest it be (a god)’ · also in a conditional protasis: ’if he were’ (εἰ τοιόσδ’ εἴη) · also in an indirect question after a past verb: ’who he was’ (τίς εἴη) · also in a negative wish with μή, ’may (no man) be’ · also potential opt. with κε in a relative clause, ’which would be’ (τό κε κέρδιον εἴη ’which would be better’) · also in a wish after αἲ γάρ, with a perf. pass. part.: ’would that it were (fulfilled)’ (αἲ γὰρ … τετελεσμένον εἴη) · also pres. opt. 3 sg. in a relative clause standing for a condition: ’(a man) who were’ (ὅς τ’ ἄλκιμος εἴη ’one who were valiant’)
εἴπ: εἶπον (aor. of λέγω/φημί) — say, tell; aor. imper. 2 sg., elided (εἴπ’ = εἰπέ)
εἴρυτο: ἐρύω (εἰρύω) — draw, pull; plpf. 3 sg. mid., epic: ’had drawn’ (a sword); the same letters can also belong to ἐρύομαι ’guard’
εἶδαρ: εἶδαρ — food, fare; neut. acc. sg., object of ἔδουσιν
εὐεργέα: εὐεργής — well-wrought; adj. (2-term.), fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted -έα (= Attic -ῆ)
εὐνὴ: εὐνή — bed, marriage-bed; fem. nom. sg.
εὐνῆς: εὐνή — bed, couch; fem. gen. sg.
εὐρὺν: εὐρύς — broad, wide; masc. acc. sg.
ζωὸς: ζωός — alive, living; masc. nom. sg.
θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before rough breathing, cf. ἔφαθ’) — and; connective particle · also with the relative ὅθι, no connective force: ὅθι θ’ ’where’ · also epic τε after a relative, no connective force (οὕς θ’ ’which’)
θαλάμοιο: θάλαμος — chamber, room; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
θείη: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. opt. 3 sg.: ’might make’ (σκέδασιν θείη ’make a scattering’) · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a wish with an infinitive: ’may (Zeus) grant (that I come)’
θεοὶ: θεός — god; nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form): ’you gods!’
θεοῖσι: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic θεοῖς)
θεὸς: θεός — god; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’as a god’ · also plain nom. sg. subject, an unspecified deity left unnamed: ’a god’ (θεὸς δ’ ἐκέδασσεν Ἀχαιούς ’a god scattered the Achaeans’) · also of a goddess (θεός is common gender) · also nom. sg. subject, of a god already introduced by epithets but not yet named: ’the god’ · also nom. sg. in apposition to a name following: θεὸς … Ἑρμείας ’a god, Hermes’
θυμαλγὲς: θυμαλγής — heart-grieving, painful; neut. nom./acc. sg.
θυμόν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (μελέων ἐξείλετο θυμόν ’took the life out of the limbs’) · also the seat of appetite: ’appetite’ (πλησαίατο θυμόν ’might satisfy their appetite’)
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
θῆκε: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔθηκε)
κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὃς δέ κ’ … ἵκηται ’whoever comes’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (καί κ’ ἐλθὼν … εἴποιμι ’and I would go and tell’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: ’would have’ (καί νύ κ’ … ἔδυ ’and … would have set’) · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’will’ (τοὺς δέ κ’ … θέλξει ’and then … will enchant them’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ μέν κ’ αἰνήσωσι ’if they approve’) · also + opt. in the protasis after εἴ: ’if perhaps’ (τόν κ’ εἴ μοι δοίης ’if you would give me him’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κ’ αὐτὸν γνώω ’if I come to know him’) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κ’ … ἐρεθίζω ’so that I may provoke’) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὥς: ’so that’ (ὥς κ’ … ἵκηται ’so that he may reach’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if you should wish’ (αἴ κ’ ἐθέλῃσθα)
κάπρον: κάπρος — wild boar; masc. acc. sg.
κάρη: κάρη — head; neut. acc. sg., acc. of respect: ’as to the head’ · also plain acc. sg., direct object of a verb: κινήσας κάρη ’shaking his head’ · also acc. sg. governed by ἀμφί: ’about the head’ (ἀμφὶ κάρη) · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’the head’ (κάρη κονίῃσιν ἐμίχθη)
κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κέ τοι λύσῃ ’so that she may free’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέ ποθι Ζεὺς δώῃ ’if Zeus should somehow grant’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἴ: ’if perhaps’ (εἴ κέ τιν’ … εὕρωμεν ’if we should find any’) · also + opt. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέ μοι … παρασταίης ’if you would stand by me’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: τῷ κέ με … ὤνησεν ’would have benefited me’ · also + fut./short-vowel aor. subj. in a main clause: κέ τοι καταλέξω ’I shall tell you’ · also + opt. in the protasis after εἴ: ’if perhaps’ (εἴ κέ μιν ἀγγείλαιμι ’if I might report him’) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κέ τοι φήνωσι ’until they show you’) · also + subj. in a prospective relative clause: ’who shall’ (ὅς κέ με κεῖσ’ ἀγάγῃ ’who shall lead me there’) · also + fut. indic. (or short-vowel subj.) in a clause after εἴ: ’whether perhaps’ (εἴ κέ σφι … τελευτήσει ’whether … it will come to pass for them’) · also + opt., potential, in a main clause: ’might’ (καί κέ τεο … πειρηθεῖμεν ’we might test any of’) · also + impf. indic., unreal past: ‘would have been’ (καί κέ τοι … ἀμφεπονεῖτο ‘would have been busy for you’) · also + opt. in a relative clause: ‘from where you would’ (ὅθεν κέ τοι … ἄλφοι)
κέν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · also + aor. indic., unreal past: κέν μοι … κατέχευας ’you would have poured on me’ · also + subj. in a main clause: ’may’ (καί κέν οἱ ὑπέρσχῃ χεῖρα ’and he may hold his hand over him’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (κέν μοι … εἴη ’would be mine’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέν τις … ὀρέξῃ ’if perhaps someone holds out’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κέν … μεταλλῶσιν ’whenever they ask’) · also + opt., potential, in a clause with ὅ ’that’: ’might’ (ὅ κέν τις … ἀμύνοι ’that someone might defend’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after ὥς: ’so that … would’ (ὥς κέν τις φαίη ’so that anyone would say’)
κέρδεα: κέρδος — gain, profit; neut. acc. pl. κέρδεα, extended sense ’cunning, craft’
καθύπερθεν: καθύπερθεν — from above, on top; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’above’ (Ὀρτυγίης καθύπερθεν ’above Ortygia’)
κακότητα: κακότης — badness, misery, trouble; fem. acc. sg.
κακὰ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl., subject: κακὰ ἔργα ’bad deeds’
κακῶν: κακός — bad, evil; neut. gen. pl.: ’of ills, of misfortunes’
καλὰ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’handsomely, finely’ (καλά … κήδεαι ’you care so finely’) · also adverbial neut. acc. pl.: ’well, finely’ (οὐκέτι καλὰ … ἀναχωρήσειν ’no longer well’) · also neut. nom. pl. (same form), agreeing with a plural subject: καλὰ θύρετρα ’the fine doors’
κατέλεξας: καταλέγω — recount, tell in order; aor. 2 sg.: ’you have recounted’
κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κε … ἐποτρύνῃ ’until … urges on’) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὅς κε πίῃ) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever, as soon as’ (ὅτε … κε θάνῃσιν; ἐπεί κε … λίπῃ) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κε … ἀκούσῃς) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κε λίσσηαι ’but if you beg’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: ’would have’ (καὶ νύ κε … βάλεν ’and she would have hurled’) · also + subj. in a disjunctive statement of what may happen: ’may’ (ἤ κε θάνωμεν ’either we may die’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (καί κε … μαχοίμην ’I would fight’) · also + subj. in a relative clause of purpose: ’who are to’ (οἵ κε … ἀγγείλωσι ’who are to announce’) · also + fut. indic. (or short-vowel subj.) in a main clause: ’will’ (αἶψά κε … ἀποτίσεται ’at once he will exact payment’) · also + aor. in a general relative clause: ’who would (decide)’ (οἵ κε … ἔκριναν) · also + opt. in a relative clause: ’whoever might’ (ὅς κε … πόροι ’whoever might offer’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κε … ἐντανύσῃς) · also + subj. in an indirect clause after ὅττι: ’what … may’ (ὅττι κε κέρδος … ἐγγυαλίξῃ ’what gain … may grant’)
κεδνὰ: κεδνός — careful, trusty; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially with ἰδυῖα: ’trusty, knowing in her heart’
κελεύεις: κελεύω — bid, command, order; pres. 2 sg.
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + secondary indic. (κατέφθιτο), unreal past conditional: ’would have perished’ · also + aor. indic. of a future event pictured as already accomplished, an eventual near-certainty rather than a counterfactual: ἤ κεν ... κτεῖνεν ’or he may well have killed (him) already’ · also + subj. in a relative clause, prospective: ’who is to, who will’ (ἥ κεν ἄγῃσι ’(a wagon) that shall carry’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … δαινύῃ ’whenever you feast’) · also + subj. in the protasis of a condition after αἴ: ’if ever’ · also + opt., potential: ’might, may’ · also + opt. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κεν … ἀφικοίμεθα ’but if we should reach’) · also + fut. indic. or short-vowel subj. in an apodosis: ’will’ (αἶψά κεν … τεύξομεν ’at once we will build’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἴ κεν … ἵκωμαι ’if I should come’) · also + subj. in a disjunctive statement of what may happen: ’may’ (ἤ κεν ἁλώῃ ’or he may be caught’) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὅς κεν ὀπυίῃ ’whoever marries’) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν ἔλθω ’until I come’) · also + fut. indic. in a main clause or an indirect disjunctive question: ’shall’ (ἤ κεν … δυνησόμεθ’ ’whether we shall be able’) · also + fut. indic. in a relative clause: ’who will’ (ὅς κεν … ἐποίσει ’who will lay on’) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κεν … καταθείομαι ’so that I may put away’) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὥς: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … πάσχῃ ’so that he may suffer’)
κεύσω: κεύθω — hide, conceal; fut. 1 sg.: ’I will hide’
κιούσῃ: κίω — go, come; pres. part. fem. dat. sg., agreeing with a dat. pronoun: ’as she came, coming’
κλαῖε: κλαίω — weep, mourn; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκλαιε): ’wept’
κύματι: κῦμα — wave; neut. dat. sg. (κύματι πηγῷ, a rare disputed epithet; see πηγῷ)
λέχος: λέχος — bed, couch; neut. nom./acc. sg.
λαοὶ: λαός — people, host, men of the community; masc. nom. pl.
λιπαρῷ: λιπαρός — sleek, bright, comfortable; neut. dat. sg., with γήραι: ’sleek (old age)’
λύτο: λύω — loose, undo; aor. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented root-aorist form (= ἐλύθη): ’was loosed, gave way’
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μάλ: μάλα (elided μάλ’) — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μάλιστα: μάλα — very, much; superl. adv. μάλιστα: ’most of all, especially’ · also ’for the most part, mostly’ (μάλιστα ἦμαρ ’the greater part of the day’)
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μέν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ (the acute μέν is kept before a following enclitic; elsewhere μὲν) · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’ (οὐ μέν ’not indeed’) · also μένω — stay, wait; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (μέν’ = μένε): ’stay’
μένοντε: μένω — stay, wait, stand firm; pres. part. masc. nom. dual: ’the two waiting’
μή: μή — not; negative particle (used with imperatives and subjunctives, unlike οὐ) · also introducing a negative purpose/fear clause with the optative in secondary sequence: μή ἑ λάθοι ’lest he should escape notice’ · also μή + fut. inf. after a verb of swearing/promising, negating its content: μή ... βουλευσέμεν ’that ... will not plan’ · also ’lest’ with the subj. after a primary verb (μή πώς ... χαλεπήνῃ ’lest he be harsh’) · also in a question expecting the answer ’no’, after ἦ: ἦ μή … φάσθ’ ἔμμεναι; ’surely you do not say … are?’ · also ’lest’ + subj. after a past verb of urging (κελόμην … μή … λάθηται ’I urged … lest he forget’) · also in a condition, ’if … not’ (εἰ … μή τίς σε βιάζεται) · also with an infinitive used as an imperative, a prohibition: μή μ’ … καταλείπειν ’do not leave me’ · also negating a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’so that … not’ (ἵνα μή τι … ἀλγήσετε ’so that you may not suffer’) · also with the optative, a negative wish: ’may … not’ (μή … ἀντιβολήσαις) · also ὡς ἂν μή + subj., negative purpose: ’so that … not’ (ὡς ἂν μή σε κατατρύχῃ ’so that he may not wear you out’) · also + subj. giving the content of an oath, ’that no one …’ (ὀμόσσατε … μή τις … πλήξῃ ’swear that no one strike’) · also μή + subj. standing alone as a warning, ’lest’ (μή τίς τοι … ἀναστῇ ’lest someone rise up against you’) · also μή + fut. indic. in a fear clause: ’lest, I fear’ (μή τίς … νεμεσήσεται ’lest anyone resent’)
μία: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; fem. nom. sg.
μεμιγμένον: μίγνυμι — mix; perf. part. pass. neut. nom. sg.: ’mixed’
μευ: ἐγώ — I; encl. gen. sg., epic μευ (= Attic μου): ’of me’, with κλύω ’hear me’ · also gen. with ἄγχι: ’near me’ (μευ ἄγχι στᾶσα) · also gen. of possession, ’my’ (οἵ μευ … κῆρ ’my heart’) · also gen. sg. with a participle: ’of me hearing’ (μευ ἀκούοντος, with φίλον ἦτορ ’heart’) · also gen. with κήδομαι: ’care for me’ (ἦ μευ … κήδεαι ’you care for me’)
μηδὲ: μηδέ — and not, nor; negative conj., companion to μή
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of the person affected, ’from my …’ (μοι βλεφάρων ἐξέσσυτο ὕπνος ’sleep rushed out from my eyelids’) · also dat. of possession with εἰμί: ’who are mine’ (οἵ μοι ἔασιν ’who are mine’)
μυθήσομαι: μυθέομαι — tell, relate, speak of; fut. 1 sg.: ’I shall tell’ · also 1 sg. with ἄν, ’I could (not) tell’ (οὐκ ἂν … μυθήσομαι οὐδ’ ὀνομήνω, perhaps a short-vowel subjunctive)
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μὴ: μή — not; negative particle in wishes, prohibitions, and purpose/fear clauses · also negating a conditional clause after εἰ: εἰ μὴ ’if not, unless’ · also negating a generic relative clause with the opt.: ὃς μὴ … ἐλάσειε ’whoever did not drive off’ · also ’lest’ in a warning, + 2 sg. fut./subj.: μὴ … ἀποτίσεαι ’lest you pay for it’ · also + inf., negating an infinitive of advice that gives the content of a word: ’not to’ (ἔπος … μὴ πάντα μνηστῆρσιν ὁμιλεῖν ’a word, not to mingle in everything with the suitors’) · also negating a generic relative clause with the subj.: ᾧ μὴ πολλοὶ ἔωσιν ’who has not many’
μᾶλλον: μάλα — very, much; comparative adv. μᾶλλον: ’more, rather, the more’
νέας: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νέας (= Attic ναῦς)
νεμέσσα: νεμεσσάω — be indignant, take offence (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, epic doubled σ (= Attic ἐνεμέσα)
νηυσὶ: ναῦς — ship; dat. pl., epic νηυσί (= Attic ναυσί)
νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
νύκτα: νύξ — night; fem. acc. sg., accusative of duration: ’(through) the night’
νῆ: ναῦς — ship; acc. sg., epic νῆα, elided (νῆ’ = νῆα)
νῶϊν: ἐγώ — I; dual gen./dat., epic (= Attic νῷν): ’for us two’
ξυμβλήμενος: συμβάλλω — meet, encounter; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic ξυν- and syncopated (= Attic συμβαλόμενος), + dat.
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’) · also encl. dat. sg. fem. ’to/for her’ (ἥ οἱ ὁμηλικίη ’who was of an age with her’) · also article-like with a numeral and noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’the’ (οἱ δὲ δύω σκόπελοι ’the two crags’) · also encl. dat. sg. of a thing, ’to/for it’ (δύω δέ τέ οἱ θύραι ’and it has two doors’) · also article-like with a noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’those, the’ (οἱ πέπλοι ’the robes’) · also dat. sg. of the giver with δέχομαι: ’from him’ (οἱ ἐδέξατο ’took from him’)
οἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl.
οἴκαδ: οἴκαδε (elided οἴκαδ’) — homeward, to home; adv., -δε suffix of direction
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (= οἱ, accented οἵ in this position) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; masc. nom. pl. ’they’, demonstrative: οἵ γ’ ὑβρισταί ’are they violent?’
οἶδα: οἶδα — know; perf. with pres. sense, 1 sg.: ’I know’
οἶκον: οἶκος — house, household (and its stores); acc. sg.
οἶκόνδε: οἶκος — house, home; acc. sg. + suffix -δε ’towards’: ’homeward’
οἶοι: οἶος — alone, only; masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic μόνοι): ’we alone’
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὕνεκά: οὕνεκα — because, for the reason that (= οὗ ἕνεκα, contracted); conj. · also ’that’, introducing what a speaker will say (= ὅτι): ἐρέει … οὕνεκά ’he will say that’
οὕτω: οὕτω(ς) — thus, so, in this way; adv.
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also masc. acc. sg.: ’all’ (πάντα δῆμον ’all the people’) · also neut. acc. pl. adverbial: ’altogether, in every respect’ (οὐκ ἄρα πάντα νοήμονες ’not altogether sensible’)
πέλονται: πέλομαι — be, become, prove to be; pres. 3 pl.
πένθος: πένθος — grief, sorrow; neut. nom./acc. sg.
πέφνῃ: πέφνω (defective, aor. only) — slay, kill; aor. subj. 3 sg., with ὅς κε: ’who shall slay’
πέφραδ: φράζω — point out, show, tell; reduplicated aor. 3 sg., elided (πέφραδ’ = πέφραδε)
πήχεε: πῆχυς — forearm, arm; masc. acc. dual, epic -εε (= Attic πήχει)
παρ: παρά (elided παρ’) — beside, among; + dat. · also + gen., ’from, from the side of’ (παρ’ Ἴλου ’from Ilus’) · also + acc., of motion, ’past, along, beside’ (παρ’ Μίμαντα ’past Mimas’)
πατρίδ: πατρίς — fatherland, native land; fem. acc. sg., elided (πατρίδ’ = πατρίδα)
πατρίδα: πατρίς — native land, fatherland; fem. acc. sg. (φίλην ... πατρίδα γαῖαν ’his dear fatherland’)
παῦροι: παῦρος — few, little; masc. nom. pl.
πείρατ: πεῖραρ — end, limit; of a rope, its ends; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (πείρατ’ = πείρατα)
περ: περ — even, though; concessive particle, esp. with a participle (= Attic καίπερ) · also used to intensify an adverb or pronoun rather than concede a point: ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’ · also after εἰ, ’if indeed, even if’: εἴ περ γάρ κεν ’if indeed ever’
περίφρων: περίφρων — circumspect, of sound understanding; fem. nom. sg., stock epithet of Penelope · also epithet of Arete: fem. nom. sg., ’the circumspect queen’ · also epithet of Eurycleia: fem. nom. sg., ’circumspect Eurycleia’
περὶ: περί — around, about; prep. + gen.: ’superior to, beyond’; also as adv.: ’exceedingly, surpassingly’ · also prep. + gen. in its plain sense ’about, concerning’ (περὶ πατρός ’about his father’) · also preverb in tmesis · + dat. · also + acc., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ ἄστυ ’around the city’) · also + gen., of place, physically ’around, encircling’ (περὶ σπείους γλαφυροῖο ’around the hollow cave’), distinct from the comparative ’beyond’ sense above · also + dat. in the fixed idiom περὶ κῆρι ’exceedingly, at heart’ (περὶ κῆρι τιμήσουσιν ’will honor him at heart’) · also + dat., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ χροῒ ’about the skin’) · also adverb of place, no case: ’round about’ (περὶ δ’ ἕρκος ἐλήλαται ’and round it a fence is driven’) · also + dat., of the thing fought over: ’over, for’ (περὶ κτεάτεσσι μαχειόμενος ’fighting over possessions’)
πηγῷ: πηγός — a rare, disputed epithet of a wave; dat. neut. sg., agreeing with κῦμα; guessed as ’massed, solid’ (from πήγνυμι) or ’strong, mighty’; no certainty is possible
πηνελόπεια: Πηνελόπεια — Penelope, wife of Odysseus; nom. sg.
πιφαύσκομαι: πιφαύσκω — make known, declare; pres. mid. 1 sg.
ποίησαν: ποιέω — make, do; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐποίησαν): ’they made’
πολιῆς: πολιός — grey; fem. gen. sg., agreeing with ἁλός · also agreeing with θαλάσσης: ’the grey sea’
πολλοὶ: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl.
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.: ’many things, greatly’ · also neut. nom. pl., plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. pl. noun (πολλὰ ... δάκρυα ’many tears’) · also neut. acc. pl., plain attributive adj. (κτήματα πολλὰ ’many possessions’) · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’again and again’ (πολλὰ περιτροπέοντες) · also neut. nom. pl. as substantive, subject: οἷά τε πολλὰ γίγνεται ’as many things happen’
πολλὴ: πολύς — much, many; fem. nom. sg.: ’much, in plenty’
πολύμητις: πολύμητις — of many wiles, epithet of Odysseus (built on μῆτις ’cunning intelligence’); masc. nom. sg.
ποσειδάων: Ποσειδῶν — Poseidon, god of the sea, enemy of Odysseus after the blinding of his son Polyphemus; nom. sg., epic uncontracted · also elided acc. sg., Ποσειδάων’ = Ποσειδάωνα: ’Poseidon’ as object
ποσειδάωνι: Ποσειδῶν — Poseidon; dat. sg., epic uncontracted
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
πρόσθεν: πρόσθεν — before, in front, formerly; adv. (τὸ πρόσθεν ’in time past, formerly’) · also prep. + gen., ’in front of, before’
πρῶτα: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’first’
πρῶτον: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’first’
πτερὰ: πτερόν — feather, wing; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl., predicate: ’wings’ (τά τε πτερὰ νηυσὶ πέλονται ’which are wings for ships’)
πυθμέν: πυθμήν — base, stock, trunk; masc. acc. sg., elided (πυθμέν’ = πυθμένα)
πυκινῶς: πυκινός — close-packed, shrewd, well-considered; adv. πυκινῶς: ’shrewdly, closely’
πυκνῇσιν: πυκνός — thick, dense; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσιν (= Attic -αῖς)
πω: πω — yet, up to now; enclitic adv., usu. with a negative
πόνος: πόνος — toil, labour, hardship; masc. nom. sg.
πόντῳ: πόντος — sea, open sea; dat. sg.
πόσις: πόσις — husband, spouse; masc. nom. sg. (distinct from πόσις ’drink’) · also πόσις — drink; fem. nom. sg. (βρῶσίς τε πόσις τε ’food and drink’)
πᾶσι: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl.
σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’ · also σός — your, yours; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (σ’ = σά): τὰ σ’ αὐτοῦ κήδε’ ’your own troubles’
σήματ: σῆμα — sign, token, mark; neut. acc. pl., elided (σήματ’ = σήματα)
στάθμην: στάθμη — carpenter’s line or rule, for marking a straight edge; fem. acc. sg.
στήθεσσι: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
σχέθεν: ἔχω — hold, check, restrain; aor. 3 sg., root aorist σχέθε, unaugmented, with movable ν (= ἔσχε)
σὴν: σός — your, yours; fem. acc. sg.
σῆμα: σῆμα — mark, sign; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’sign’ (τόδε σῆμα τετύχθω ’let this sign be made’)
σῷ: σός — your, yours; masc./neut. dat. sg.
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’) · also in ἦ τ’ (= ἦ τε), a strengthened affirmation: ’truly, surely’ (ἦ τ’ ἂν πολὺ κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would surely have been far better’) · also after a relative of size or amount, with no connective force: ὅσην τ’ ὄρεος κορυφήν ’as large as a mountain’s peak’ · also after ἤ ’than’, with no connective force: ἤ τ’ οἰωνοί ’than birds’ · also after ὅ ‘that’, with no connective force: ὅ τ’ οὐκέτι νόστιμός ἐστιν ‘that he is no longer returning’
τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.; also relative: ’which’ (accented τά before a following enclitic) · also article-like with ἄλλα, ’the other (things)’ (τά περ ἄλλα ’in the other matters’) · also article-like before an adverb, ’the (things) within’ (τά τ’ ἔνδοθι)
τέτυκται: τεύχω — make, build; pass. come to pass, happen; perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’has been made, has come to pass’
τί: τίς, τί — who? what?; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially ’why’ · also the enclitic indefinite τις, τι ’someone, something’ (accented τί before an enclitic): neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a negative, ’at all’ (οὔ τι) · adj. · also plain interrogative, direct object/predicate: ’what’ (τί πάθω ’what am I to suffer’; τί ... γένηται ’what is to become’) · also the enclitic indefinite as an adjective agreeing with a noun, accented before enclitic που: εἴ τί που εἴλυμα ’if any wrapper’ · also enclitic indefinite with a negative, ’anything’, as accusative subject of an infinitive (οὐ … τί φημι κακώτερον ἄλλο … συγχεῦαι ’I say nothing else is worse’) · also enclitic indefinite, adverbial without a negative: ’somehow, in some way’ (τοῦτό τί μοι κάλλιστον ’this seems to me somehow the fairest’) · also enclitic indefinite as an adjective after μή, accented before an enclitic: ’any’ (μή τί τοι … πῆμα ’any harm to you’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective after ὅπως, accented before enclitic μοι: ’any’ (τί … ἄλγος ’any pain’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective after ἤ, accented before the enclitic μοι: ’any’ (ἤ τί μοι … κειμήλιον ’or any treasure of mine’) · also the enclitic indefinite as a substantive object after εἴ: ’anything’ (εἴ τί μιν εἴποι ’whether she would say anything to him’)
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc. nom. sg. · also the enclitic indefinite τις accented before a following enclitic, not interrogative: ’someone, anyone’ (ἤν τίς τοι εἴπῃσι ’if someone tells you’)
ταμὼν: τέμνω — cut; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having cut, cutting’
τανύφυλλος: τανύφυλλος — long-leaved; adj., fem. nom. sg., of the olive
ταρπώμεθα: τέρπομαι — take one’s fill of, enjoy (+ dat.); aor. subj. mid. 1 pl.: ’we may take our fill’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τειρεσίαο: Τειρεσίας — Tiresias, the Theban seer; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
τελέσσαι: τελέω — bring to pass, accomplish; aor. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic τελέσαι)
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’ · also adjectival indefinite: ’some, any’ (τι δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’) · also adverbial without a negative: ’in some way, in some measure’ (τι κατὰ πρῆξιν ’on some business’) · also as a substantive object, in a question: ’anything, something’ (ἦ ῥά τι ἴδμεν ’do we know anything’) · also the neut. of τις forming, with a preceding ὅ, the indefinite relative ὅ τι ’whatever, that which’ (αὔδα ὅ τι φρονέεις ’say whatever you have in mind’) · also ὅ τι as an adverbial acc. in an indirect question: ’why’ · also as a substantive object in a statement: ’something’ (καί τι ἴσασι ’they know something’) · also neut. acc. sg. as object with a negative: ’anything’ (οὐδέ τι ῥέξαι ’nor to have done anything’)
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’
τοί: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl. ’they’ · also relative: ’who’ · also encl. dat. sg. pron. σύ ’to you’ (= τοι, accented before a following enclitic, e.g. τοί τι) · also τοι, the affirming particle, accented τοί before an enclitic: ἀλλ’ ἦ τοί σε ’but truly you’
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl.: ’they’; also relative: ’who’ · also τοι, the affirming particle (ἀλλ’ ἦ τοι ’but truly’), as the grave-accented form τοὶ
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. pl. (ἀέθλους, τοὺς … ἐπειρήσαντο Ὀδυσῆος ’the contests with which they tried Odysseus’) · also demonstrative with a noun: masc. acc. pl. ’those, the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους … ἑταίρους ’the rest of my companions’)
τοῖος: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; masc. nom. sg. (τοῖος ... οἷον ’such as’)
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. gen. sg. ’of him, that one’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whose, of whom; masc. gen. sg. (τοῦ νῶι θεοῦ ὣς τερπόμεθ’ αὐδῇ ’whose voice we delight in’) · also demonstrative gen. of comparison after a comparative: τοῦ γε κρεῖσσον ’better than this’ · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ: ’from that time’ · also neut. gen. sg., partitive, ’of it’ (τοῦ μὲν ὅσον τ’ ὄργυιαν ’of it, about a fathom’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the’ (τοῦ παιδὸς ’that son’) · also article-like gen. sg. with a noun and a participle (gen. absolute), distributive: ’of the one … of the other’ (τοῦ μὲν φθίνοντος μηνός, τοῦ δ’ ἱσταμένοιο ’as one month wanes and the other begins’)
τοῦτο: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. sg.
τόδ: ὅδε — this, this here; neut. nom./acc. sg., elided (τόδ’ = τόδε)
τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. sg.
τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also in the adverbial idiom τὰ πρῶτα, ’at first, first’ (not ’these things’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’those, the’ (τὰ σὰ γούνατα ’those knees of yours’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: which; neut. nom. pl. (μῆλα, τὰ … κατάκειτ’ ’the flocks, which lie’) · also relative, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’, object of the verb in its clause (ῥωγαλέα, τὰ … ὅρηαι ’torn, which you see’) · also article-like with a substantivized adjective, neut.: ’the (worse things)’ (τὰ χέρεια) · also neut. acc. pl. ’them’, of the cow and the goats · also article-like before an adverb, ’the (things) outside’ (τὰ θύρηφι)
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg. ’her’ · also ’it’, of a thing (τὴν = the clothing): fem. acc. sg. · also with a noun, article-like: τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom; fem. acc. sg. (τὴν Ὠκεανὸς τέκε ’whom Oceanus begot’) · also ’the other’, contrasted with a preceding τὴν … μέν: fem. acc. sg. (τὴν δέ ’the other one’) · also article-like with a numeral: ’the one’ (τὴν μὲν ἴαν ’the one portion’)
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. (τὸ πάροιθεν ’that which was before’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’that, the’ (τὸ σῆμα ’that mark’) · also article-like before the adverb πάρος: ’as before’ (ὡς τὸ πάρος περ) · also article-like before an ordinal, adverbial: τὸ τρίτον ’the third time’ · also distributive, neut. nom./acc. sg.: τὸ μὲν … τὸ δὲ ’one thing … another’ · also article-like before the adverb πρόσθεν: ’formerly’ (τὸ πρόσθεν ὄλοντο ’died long before’) · also article-like before a substantivized adjective, neut.: τὸ μέλαν ’the dark (part)’ · also article-like before the adverb πάροιθε: ’formerly’ (τὸ πάροιθε ’in former times’) · also article-like before an infinitive, which it makes a noun: ’the (keeping watch)’ (τὸ φυλάσσειν) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: which; neut. acc. sg., object of its clause (τὸ πρὶν μέν ῥ’ ἐφόρει ’which he used to carry before’) · also demonstrative, neut. acc. sg., object of a verb: ’this, that’ (τὸ δὲ νήπιοι οὐκ ἐνόησαν ’but the fools did not perceive this’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’) · also demonstrative, distributive: masc. acc. sg. ’the one … the other’ (τὸν μὲν … τὸν δ’) · also article-like with a participle: τὸν ἐόντα ’me, the one who am’ · also article-like with a superlative or ordinal: ’the best’ (τὸν ἄριστον), ’the fourth’ (τὸν τέταρτον) · also article-like with a substantivized adjective: ’the like (one)’ (τὸν ὁμοῖον)
τῆς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); fem. gen. sg. · also fem. gen. sg. with the force of a relative: ’of which’ (τῆς ἕτερον μὲν θειλόπεδον ’of which one part is a drying-ground’) · also with a name, article-like: ’that’ (τῆς Σκύλλης ’of that Scylla’) · also article-like with a noun: ’the, that’ (τῆς ληΐδος ’that booty’) · also article with αὐτῆς, ’the same’: τῆς αὐτῆς ἀγγελίης ’the same news’

ἕρκεος: ἕρκος — fence, enclosing wall; also snare, net; neut. gen. sg., epic -εος (= Attic -ους)
ἠΰτε: ἠΰτε — like as, even as; epic particle introducing a comparison
ἠώς: ἠώς — dawn; fem. nom. sg. (personified Ἠώς, Attic Ἕως)
ἠῶ: ἠώς (Attic ἕως) — dawn; acc. sg., accusative of extent: ’on into the dawn’ · also acc. after πρός: ’towards the dawn, the east’ (πρὸς ἠῶ) · also direct object of a verb of waiting: ’(waited for) Dawn’ (ἐμείναμεν Ἠῶ δῖαν) · also direct object of a verb of reaching: ’reach the dawn, live to see daybreak’ (ἠῶ ἵκοιτο)
ἡμέας: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; acc. pl., epic ἡμέας (= Attic ἡμᾶς)
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
ἣν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (fem. acc. sg.)
ἤ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj., accented before an enclitic (ἤ κεν); ἤ … ἦε ’whether … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative: μεῖζον … ἤ ’greater than’ · also ’than’, ’rather than’, after a verb of preferring (βούλομ’ … ἤ τινα ’I prefer … to any’) · also the first of two alternatives, accented before an enclitic: ’either … or’ (ἤ ῥά νύ που … ἢ ὅ γ’ ’either … or’)
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤλθομεν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. 1 pl.: ’we came’
ἤματι: ἦμαρ — day; neut. dat. sg., epic ἤματι
ἤπειρόνδε: ἤπειρος — mainland; fem. acc. sg. + directional suffix -δε: ’to the mainland’
ἥβης: ἥβη — youth, young manhood, prime of life; fem. gen. sg. (ἥβης μέτρον ’the measure of manhood’)
ἥν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (fem. acc. sg.) · also relative + indefinite, in the compound ἥν τινα = ἥτις (fem.): ’whatever, what’
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’) · also ’or’, the second alternative of a pair of questions with no preceding ἠέ: ζώει … ἦ τέθνηκε ’alive or dead’; ἢ ἔτ’ ἔχει … ἦ μιν ἀτιμάζουσιν ’whether … or’
ἦέ: ἠέ — or; disjunctive conj., epic by-form (variant accentuation ἦε)
ἧς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. gen. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whose, of whom/which (fem. gen. sg.)
ἰδυῖαν: οἶδα — know; perf. part. fem. acc. sg., epic ἰδυῖα (= Attic εἰδυῖα): ’knowing’
ἰθὺς: ἰθύς — straight; prep. + gen. (epic = Attic εὐθύς): ’straight towards’ · also adv., no case expressed: ’straight, straight on’
ἱερὰ: ἱερός — sacred, holy; neut. acc. pl. ’sacred rites, offerings’ · also attributive, agreeing with δώματα: ’sacred (halls)’ (ἱερὰ πρὸς δώματα)
ἱερὰς: ἱερός — sacred, holy; fem. acc. pl.
ἱκέσθαι: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, arrive at; aor. inf.
ἱμάντα: ἱμάς — strap, thong (esp. of a door-latch); masc. acc. sg.
ἴδον: ὁράω — see; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδον) · also aor. 3 pl. (the same ending serves both persons): ’they saw’
ἴομεν: εἶμι — go; pres. subj. 1 pl. (hortatory): ’let us go’ · also subj. in a temporal clause with ἄν/κε: ’we go, are going’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … ἀγροὺς ἴομεν ’while we go through the fields’)
ἵκετο: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 sg.; where the metre makes the ι long, that is the augment, which the spelling cannot show; with short ι, unaugmented
ἵμερον: ἵμερος — longing, desire, yearning; masc. acc. sg.
ὀΐω: ὀΐομαι — think, suppose; pres. 1 sg. (act. form ὀΐω, epic; = Attic οἴομαι): ’I think’
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀδυσῆϊ: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. dat. sg., epic Ὀδυσῆϊ (single σ, diaeresis; = Ὀδυσσῆϊ, Attic Ὀδυσσεῖ)
ὀπώπει: ὁράω — see; pluperf. 3 sg. (perf. ὄπωπα), epic (= Attic ἑωράκει): ’he had seen’
ὀϊζύν: ὀϊζύς — misery, woe, distress; fem. acc. sg.
ὁδίτης: ὁδίτης — wayfarer, traveller; masc. nom. sg.
ὁππότε: ὁππότε (Attic ὁπότε) — whenever, when; conj., + subj. and κε in a general temporal clause · also introducing an indirect question, + pres. indic.: ’when’ (ὁππότε Τηλέμαχος νεῖτ(αι) ’when Telemachus is to return’) · also + subj. without κε, in a general clause: ’whenever’ (ὁππότε τις μνήσῃ ’whenever anyone mentions’) · also + opt., of what may happen in time to come: ’whenever he should’ (ὁππότε νοστήσειε ’whenever he should come home’) · also + indic., of a recurring case: ’whenever’ (ὁππότε θυμὸς ἄνωγε ’whenever the heart bids’) · also + fut. indic., after a verb of waiting: ‘for the moment when’ (δέγμενος … ὁππότε … ἐφήσει ‘waiting for when he will lay on’)
ὄλβιοι: ὄλβιος — blessed, prosperous; masc. nom. pl.
ὄπισθεν: ὄπισθεν — behind, from behind; adv. · also of time: ’afterwards, hereafter’ (ἄμμες ὄπισθεν ἀρεσσάμενοι ’we afterwards making amends’)
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἔτι κεῖνος ἀνὴρ ἐπιδήμιος ἦεν ’as long as that man was still at home’) · also ’while’ + ἄν and subj. · also temporal ’until’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἵκετ’ Ἀρήτην ’until he came to Arete’) · also ’until’ + ἄν and subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἵκηαι ’until you reach’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary verb: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ … μένοιεν) · also temporal ’until’ + opt., of a hoped-for event (ὄφρ’ ἐξεμέσειεν ’until she should vomit out’) · also ὄφρ’ ἂν + opt., ’until … should’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἄγοιεν ’until they should carry’) · also temporal + subj. without ἄν or κε, ’so long as’ (ὄφρ’ ἀρετὴν παρέχωσι … καὶ γούνατ’ ὀρώρῃ ’so long as the gods furnish excellence and his knees are stirring’)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’until’, + indic. (ὄφρα ... βάλε): marking the point an action ceases · also temporal + subj. with κε, correlative with τόφρα: ’as long as, until’ (ὄφρα κε κείνη τοῦτον ἔχῃ νόον ’for as long as she holds this purpose’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary-sequence verb: ὄφρα ... ἕλοις/ἵκοιο ’so that you might take/arrive’ · also temporal + indic., ’as long as’ (ὄφρα μὲν … ἦν ’so long as it was’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg.; with γε: ’he’ · also relative, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’who’ (ὅ κε ... ἐφείη) · also = ὅτι ’that’; εἰς ὅ ’until’ · also relative, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὅ οἱ πέρι δῶκεν Ἀθήνη ’which Athena gave her beyond others’) · also masc. nom. sg. pronoun ’he’ without γε, accented before an enclitic (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also with τις, an indirect interrogative: οὐκ οἶδ’ ὅς τις ’I know not who’ · also with τις, indefinite relative: ὅς τις … φάγοι ’whoever should eat’
ὅτ: ὅτε (elided ὅτ’) — when; temporal conj., here + ἄν and subj. in a general/future clause · also + indic., of a single definite past event: ’when’ (ὅτ’ ἐν Ἄργεϊ ... ἵστασαν ’when they were mooring in Argos’) · also + opt., in a repeated past clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂψ ἄρχοιτο ’whenever he began again’) · also + subj. without ἄν, in a general clause: ὅτ’ … ἔχῃ ’whenever … holds’ · also in ὡς ὅτ’, ’as when (a minstrel does)’, the verb left unexpressed · also in ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ introducing a simile with a finite verb expressed: ’as when’ (ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ … ἁλιεὺς … προΐησι) · also causal + indic.: ’since, because’ (ὅτ’ οὐκ ἐθέλουσι δικαίως ’since they are not willing to act justly’) · also + opt., of a time conceived as possible: ’when’ (ὅτ’ … λιποίμην ’when I should be left behind’) · also in ὡς ὅτ’ introducing a simile with the finite verb expressed: ’as when’ (ὡς ὅτ’ ἀνὴρ … ἐτάνυσσε ’as when a man … stretches’)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when; temporal conjunction · also ’since, now that’ (ὅτε πρότερός γε πύθοιτο ’since he learned of it first’) · also with the optative, hypothetical/conditional: ’if ever, whenever’ (ὅτε ... ἵκοι ’if ever such need should come upon me’) · also with the subjunctive, general: ’whenever’ (ὅτε στείχῃσ’ ἀνὰ ἄστυ ’whenever she goes through the town’) · also with the optative, iterative in past time: ’whenever’ (ὅτε μέλλοι ’whenever he was about to’) · also with the pres. indic., ’whereas, when’ (ὅτε τ’ ἄλλοι ἅπαξ θνῄσκουσ’ ἄνθρωποι ’whereas other men die only once’) · also in ὅτε μή, ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ θεὸς … θείη ’unless a god should make’)
ὑφ: ὑπό (elided ὑφ’, before a rough breathing) — under, beneath; + gen., dat. or acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (ὑφ’ ... ὦρσε = ὑπῶρσε ’aroused’)
ὕπνῳ: ὕπνος — sleep; masc. dat. sg. (ὕπνῳ γλυκερῷ ’sweet sleep’)
ὕπο: ὑπό — under, in; postpositive prep. + dat., anastrophe (ὕπνῳ ὕπο = ὑπὸ ὕπνῳ): ’in (sweet sleep)’ · also as a preverb apart from its verb (tmesis): φυγὼν ὕπο = ὑποφυγών ’having escaped’ (φυγὼν ὕπο νηλεὲς ἦμαρ ’having escaped the pitiless day’) · also + gen. of agent, postpositive: Κικόνων ὕπο ’at the hands of the Cicones’ · also postpositive + gen., ’under, by the light of’ (δαΐδων ὕπο λαμπομενάων ’under flaring torches’) · also postpositive + acc., ’beneath’ (γαῖαν ὕπο ’beneath the earth’) · also postpositive + acc.: ’beneath, under’ (ἄλσος ὕπο ’beneath a grove’)
ὠκεανῷ: Ὠκεανός — Ocean, the river around the earth; masc. dat. sg.
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’ · also comparative ’like’, placed after the noun it compares (ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή ’like a blast of wind’) · also ὡς εἰ ’as if, like’ (ὡς εἰ πτερὸν ἠὲ νόημα ’as if a wing or a thought’) · also ὡς + ἄν + opt., potential, ’as, in the way that, such as’ (ὡς οὐκ ἂν ἔλποιο ’such as you would not expect’) · also introducing a simile with the subj. and no ἄν: ’as when (a woman weeps)’ · also in an asseveration with fut. indic., ’as surely as’ (ὡς οὐκ ὀφθαλμόν γ’ ἰήσεται ’as surely as nothing will heal the eye’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. with a finite verb: ’how (dear) he is’ (ὡς ὅδε … φίλος … ἐστίν) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., of manner: ’as’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I shall say’) · also comparative ’like’, standing before its noun (ὡς νυκτερίς ’like a bat’) · also ὡς ὅθ’ (= ὡς ὅτε), ’as when’, comparing with an occasion in the past (ὡς ὅθ’ ὑπὸ Τροίην ’as when beneath Troy’) · also introducing an indirect statement after a verb of saying: ’that, how’ (εἴποιμ’ ὡς … ἔρχομαι ’I might tell how I am coming’) · also ὡς ἄν + opt., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἄν τίς σε … μακαρίζοι ’so that someone … would call you blessed’) · also ὡς + participle, ’as one who’ (ὡς ἐκ θανάτοιο φυγόντα ’as one escaped from death’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν … ἔρχησθον ’so that you two may go’) · also ὡς = ’to, toward’ + acc. of a person (ὡς τὸν ὁμοῖον ’to the like’) · also exclamatory ὡς + finite verb: ’how’ (ὡς ὁ μολοβρὸς … ἀγορεύει ’how the glutton talks’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’ · also introducing a wish with the optative: ’so may…’ (ὣς ἔμ’ ἀϊστώσειαν ’so may they make me vanish’)
ὤρορεν: ὄρνυμι — stir up, rouse, urge on; aor. 3 sg., reduplicated form, unaugmented: ’roused, stirred up’
ὦρσε: ὄρνυμι — stir up, rouse, set in motion; aor. 3 sg.: ’stirred up, roused’
ὧδ: ὧδε — so, thus, in this way; adv., elided (ὧδ’ = ὧδε)
ὧν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. gen. pl. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: of whom, whose; gen. pl., partitive (τοὺς δ’ ὧν ἐθέλει ’whomever he wishes’), not the possessive
ᾔδη: οἶδα — know; plpf. 3 sg. with past sense (= impf.): ’knew’
ῥέξαι: ῥέζω — do, perform, esp. offer sacrifice; aor. inf.: ’to offer’ (ῥέξαι ἑκατόμβας ’to offer hecatombs’) · also aor. inf. ’to do’ (οὐδέ τι ῥέξαι ἀτάσθαλον ’nor to have done anything wanton’)
ῥηϊδίως: ῥηΐδιος — easy; adv. ῥηϊδίως: ’easily, readily’, epic (= Attic ῥᾳδίως)
ῥοδοδάκτυλος: ῥοδοδάκτυλος — rose-fingered; fem. nom. sg., epithet of Dawn
